description: List documents in the user's AiDocX document management. Returns all document types (contracts, proposals, quotations, resumes, reports, etc.). Supports pagination.

folderId.description: Folder ID to list (UUID). Omit for root folder.

limit.description: Maximum number of documents to return (1-100). Default: 50

offset.description: Number of documents to skip. Default: 0

name: list_documents
